db_path.description: Path to the directory where udev stores its database of device nodes.

dev_dir.description: Path to the directory where udev populates device nodes.

firmware_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories where udev searches for firmware files.

default_mode.description: Default file permission mode (octal) for device nodes created by udev.

default_owner.description: Default owner (user:group) for device nodes created by udev.

event_timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds udev waits for an external program to complete before terminating it.

logging.description: Whether udev logs messages to syslog.

logging_priority.description: Syslog priority level for udev messages (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'notice', 'warning', 'err', 'crit', 'alert', 'emerg').

rule_engine.description: Rule engine mode. Use 'static' for built-in rule engine; 'dynamic' is deprecated and not recommended.

workers.description: Number of worker threads udev uses to process events in parallel.
